# Foreign keys between owning areas

<!-- Generated by backend/gates/entitymodel_test.go. Do not edit by hand. -->

[Back to the entity model](README.md).

Each foreign key crossing an owning-area boundary adds a dependency. Composite keys count once. Internal keys stay within their area and are excluded from the inbound and outbound counts.

An area with no inbound key is a candidate for a separate module. Its outbound keys need replacement enforcement if moved across the extension boundary. Cascades also need a replacement cleanup path. Calls, events and product scope need a separate review.
